collegeInfo: Established in 1991, Cummins College of Engineering for Women is a premier women’s engineering institute in Pune and among the top choices for girl students across Maharashtra. With NAAC and NBA accreditations and strong industry linkages, Cummins College provides holistic technical education and excellent placement opportunities in leading companies worldwide.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to top-performing students in qualifying exams (MHT-CET/JEE Main) and to those with consistent academic merit.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatically considered based on academic records at admission.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: For reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/SBC, EWS, etc.) as per State and Central Government norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through the Maharashtra state scholarship portal after admission.

events.eventFullDescription: Cummunity is Cummins College’s annual technical festival. It features coding competitions, robotics, paper presentations, workshops, and expert talks, aimed at fostering technical skills, innovation, and leadership among women engineers.

Dhruva is the college's flagship cultural festival, celebrating music, dance, theatre, literature, and art. It brings together students to showcase their creative and organizational skills, and is attended by participants from colleges across Pune.

collegeName: Cummins College of Engineering for Women

infrastructure.infraDescription: The Cummins campus in Karve Nagar features well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi-enabled smart classrooms, a large central library, a vibrant innovation center, and hostels. It provides sports facilities, medical support, canteen, and counseling services, creating an enabling environment for academic and all-round development.
